About Music Explorer

Music Explorer · Version 2.0

Created by Geoff Peters and Gabriel Lo. Originally a Windows program from 2003 (C++/MFC); this is a port to the browser.

Open a recording, drag across the waveform to select a moment, and the spikes that appear above the piano keyboard show which notes are sounding. Press a key to hear its pitch and match it against a spike.

Your audio never leaves this page; files are decoded and analysed locally.
